description.zh: 两个音之间的距离用半音数来量，在十二平均律里每升一个半音频率乘 2^(1/12)，升 12 个半音正好翻倍成高八度；所以听起来等距的音程，在频率上是等比而不是等差。
description.en: The distance between two notes is counted in semitones; in twelve-tone equal temperament each semitone multiplies the frequency by 2^(1/12), so 12 semitones exactly double it — an octave; intervals that sound evenly spaced are equal ratios, not equal differences, in frequency.

aliases.zh: 为什么高八度听起来像同一个音
aliases.en: why does an octave sound like the same note

description.zh: 在一个调里，和弦按所在的音阶级数扮演不同角色：主功能（I）站稳、前属功能（IV、ii）做准备、属功能（V）制造张力；终止式就是这些角色的衔接，V–I 像句号，IV–I 温和落地，停在 V 上像逗号。
description.en: Within a key, chords play roles set by their scale degree: tonic (I) feels settled, predominant (IV, ii) prepares, dominant (V) builds tension; a cadence links these roles — V–I like a full stop, IV–I a gentle landing, stopping on V like a comma.

aliases.zh: 主和弦 属和弦 下属和弦
为什么 V–I 听起来像结束

label.en: Intervals live on a logarithmic scale

reason.zh: 频率按 2^(n/12) 等比增长，半音数 n = 12·log₂(f/f₀) 就是频率比的对数——耳朵听到的“等距”，正是对数刻度上的等距。
reason.en: Frequencies grow as 2^(n/12), so the semitone count n = 12·log₂(f/f₀) is the logarithm of the frequency ratio — the even steps the ear hears are even steps on a logarithmic scale.

reason.zh: 声音是介质里疏密的振动，频率越高听起来越高；把音高换成频率，音程才能写成频率比来计算。
reason.en: Sound is a travelling pattern of compression in a medium, and a higher frequency sounds higher; once pitch is read as frequency, an interval can be computed as a frequency ratio.

label.en: Scale degrees come from semitone positions

reason.zh: 大调里每一级离主音有固定的半音数（0、2、4、5、7、9、11），和弦在这些级数上按三度叠起来，它的功能也由所在级数决定。
reason.en: Each degree of a major scale sits a fixed number of semitones above the tonic (0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11); chords are stacked in thirds on those degrees, and each chord’s function follows from its degree.
